description: Slice one prepared wallpaper canvas into seamless per-display crops at each monitor's true physical position, then set each display's wallpaper by id.

displays.description: List every display (id, name, origin, size) and its seamless crop window, plus the arrangement bounding box (= the size your canvas must be).

seam-check.description: Reconstruct the physical desk from the canvas (crops composited at their positions, edges outlined) to verify seamlessness before applying. Writes a preview PNG.

args.name: canvas
args.description: Prepared canvas, sized to the arrangement bbox

apply.description: Carve the canvas into per-display timestamped crops and set each as wallpaper. Pass name=WxH+X+Y to override a physically-separated screen (e.g. a prompter); --no-set to carve only; --resize to cover-crop a mis-sized canvas.

args.name: canvas
args.description: Prepared canvas, sized to the arrangement bbox

args.name: out-dir
args.description: Where crops are written (default: canvas's folder)
